Explain why the perpendicular-bisector construction produces points equidistant from both endpoints.
items.answer: The construction draws equal-radius arcs from each endpoint; their intersections are the same distance from both endpoints, which is exactly the set of points on the perpendicular bisector.

steps: Equal arcs from both ends give equidistant points.
